profile.headline: Software Engineer and Product Specialist
profile.summary: Full Stack Software Developer.  Technologies: JavaScript/TypeScript, NodeJS, React, Angular, MySQL, MongoDB, Java, C++, PHP, Python

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Senior software engineer developing full-stack solutions and responsive, performant user interfaces for media-related applications. Meta contingent worker on assignment through Tundra Technical Solutions.

company.name: Purple Rock Scissors • A Strategic Creative Agency

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineering consultant supporting clients of Purple Rock Scissors.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed responsive web applications using React.js, Angular, and JavaScript.
- Utilized SASS for efficient and modular CSS styling.
- Implemented CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.
- Contributed to the development of Laravel and Spring Boot-based backend services.

positions.title: Software Application Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained RESTful APIs using Spring Boot and Java for Disney's internal systems.
- Implemented SAML 2.0 authentication and authorization mechanisms for secure access to APIs.
- Integrated with MariaDB for data persistence and querying.
- Followed agile development practices and collaborated with cross-functional teams.
positions.insights: Skills: MariaDB · REST APIs · SAML 2.0 · Spring Boot · Java

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the development of Meta's Family Center site and Education Hub using internal resources and
proprietary stack.
- Collaborated with design and product teams to translate requirements and designs into functional web
applications.
- Ensured code quality, performance, and adherence to best practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded the development of the WhatsApp For Business website (business.whatsapp.com)
using a proprietary tech stack.
- Implemented complex functionality and designs to deliver an award-winning, company-branded user
experience.
- Coordinated with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure project success.

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description:
- Served as the technical lead for the livetrends.com website development project.
- Managed a team of developers, conducted code reviews, and ensured adherence to best practices.
- Collaborated with designers and stakeholders to translate designs into functional web applications.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Created a React component library from Dell's corporate-branded assets and published it as an
internal NPM package.
- The package was integrated into the customer-facing website, www.dell.com, for a consistent branded
user experience.
- Ensured seamless integration of the component library with existing codebases.
